coordinate_frame.name: ws_map
coordinate_frame.conversion: identity source-world vertices; do not recenter or rotate one representation independently
coordinate_frame.origin: the scan's map frame; not the room centre or the robot's start
coordinate_frame.robot_frame_transform: T_map_robot comes from the robot's localization; apply its inverse to map coordinates
coordinate_frame.glb_import_note: Vertex coordinates already contain ws_map positions. Mesh-node transforms remain unchanged. Named semantic anchors are additional mesh-free scene roots.
coordinate_frame.orientation_note: No object pose orientation is inferred from world AABB axes. Use original mesh transforms/geometry; a grasp frame is not supplied.
